_test.setup:
d="${HOME}/pw/tests/design-explorer/generic-study"; mkdir -p "$d"; echo CONVERGED > "$d/status"; k=0; for g in 1 2; do for j in 1 2 3 4; do k=$((k+1)); c="$d/iter_$g/case_$j"; mkdir -p "$c/images"; awk -v k=$k 'BEGIN {x1=(k*0.37)%1; x2=(k*0.61)%1; printf "%g x1
%g x2
", x1, x2 > "/dev/stderr"; printf "%g f1
%g f2
", x1*x1+0.1*x2, (1-x1)*(1-x1)+0.1*x2}' 2> "$c/params.in" > "$c/results.out"; echo iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAADUlEQVR42mNk+M9QDwADhgGAWjR9awAAAABJRU5ErkJggg== | base64 -d > "$c/images/contour.png"; done; done
